contract.title: Wave A: semantic-search-candidate-trace.ts trace_v2 exact-key parser
contract.invariant: The trace_v2 parser rejects unknown top-level keys and round-trips canonically. A1 owns the parser ONLY; B1 (Wave B) owns the trace recording implementation inside vector-candidate-fusion.ts. Wave A changes no central runtime file.
production_callers: packages/core/src/core/vector-candidate-fusion.ts (A1 trace anchor: VECTOR_CANDIDATE_RRF_K_V1=100 at :12; B1 adds raw-arm/core-fusion trace recording in Wave B, requires A1 per §7.2)
interface_changes: packages/core/src/core/semantic-search-candidate-trace.ts (new file; trace_v2 exact-key parser; A1 is the parser owner, B1 is the implementation owner)
security_boundaries: Unknown top-level trace keys are rejected (fail-closed exact-key parsing; §7.6 A1 RED row rejects_unknown_trace_v2_keys)
overlap_with: B1 (Wave B): core trace implementation consumes A1 (B1 requires A1 per §7.2 exact prerequisite table)
R1.1: sealed feature contract index is the binding authority for trace fields (A1 requires R1.6, R1.1)
contract.instructions: Create packages/core/src/core/semantic-search-candidate-trace.ts (does not exist at round_base) as the trace_v2 exact-key parser. §7.5 A1 row: 'trace parser'. §7.6 A1 RED row: test packages/core/src/core/semantic-search-candidate-trace.test.ts - 'rejects_unknown_trace_v2_keys'; expected failure before implementation: trace parser accepts an unknown top-level key; minimal passing behavior: exact-key parsing rejects it. Round-trip must be canonical and stable. Do NOT touch vector-candidate-fusion.ts (B1's file in Wave B). Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5) and targets a test file that does not exist at round_base: unverifiable-at-base; run only after the file exists. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-core test is repo-verified (packages/core/package.json 'test' script; .github/workflows/ci.yml:147) and must pass with unchanged product output.
